Monday Night No-Drop Road Ride (MNNDR)

Des Moines, IA

No-drop

Monday Night No-Drop Road Ride (MNNDR) is a road group ride in Des Moines, IA. It starting at Great Western Trail trailhead. Expect about 20 miles, ~17 mph average, conversational; riders should be able to hold 14 mph.

About the Monday Night No-Drop Road Ride (MNNDR) group ride

A 20-mile no-drop road ride with regroup points, led by members of a local race team. Weekly prize drawings from sponsors. Listed on the DSM Group Rides calendar alongside the Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday rides.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
